method: Compared with the pdftotext text layer of the official PDF (SHA-256 checked) using -layout, -raw and -table modes, and its official marking scheme (same PDF, pages 12-19).

source.notes: sha256sum of .sources-cache/p3/isc-2027-xii-physics-specimen/source.pdf matches source.sha256. sourceUrl is cisce.org (the CISCE board's own site). Title/board/class/subject/examYear/paperType/maxMarks(70)/durationMinutes(180, +15 min reading time noted separately) all match the PDF's cover instructions. Minor: source.notes says the answer key is '7 printed pages (PDF pages 12-19)'; PDF pages 12-19 is 8 pages and the key's own footers are numbered 1-8 ('8 ISC SPECIMEN ANSWER KEY 2027' on PDF page 19), so the printed-page count in the notes text is off by one. Does not affect any question data.
